  for +owner: String

proofBodies.4b1bd6dff6fc532793d25c1ed2f415d59eef4340:
def redirect_workers_preserves(workers, owner, roots):
  match workers:
    case Nil{}: {==}
    case Con{H.NF_Worker{+name, +params, +code, +deps, +shape}, +rest}:
      +redirect = "if (" ++ H.no_shared_roots(params, roots, 0) ++ ") { return " ++ H.nf_name(H.no_adapter_name(owner)) ++ "(e, seq, nf_out" ++ H.nf_arg_c(H.nf_segment_args(params)) ++ "); }\n"
      +adapter = H.no_adapter_name(owner)
      redirect_list_cons(
        H.NF_Worker{name, params, H.nt_choose(H.NC_Code, H.p88_string_eq(name, owner), u => H.nc_prepend(redirect, code), u => code), H.nt_choose(List<&2, String>, H.p88_string_eq(name, owner), u => Con{adapter, deps}, u => deps), shape},
        H.nt_choose(H.NF_Worker, H.p88_string_eq(name, owner), u => H.NF_Worker{name, params, H.nc_prepend(redirect, code), Con{adapter, deps}, shape}, u => H.NF_Worker{name, params, code, deps, shape}),
        H.no_scalar_redirect_reference(rest, owner, roots), H.no_scalar_redirect(rest, owner, roots),
        redirect_worker_choice(H.p88_string_eq(name, owner), name, params, code, deps, shape, redirect, adapter),
        redirect_workers_preserves(rest, owner, roots))

interpretation: Counts distinct named contracts/lemmas, not summed repeated check counts.
Statement and proof-body hashes omit blank lines and full-line comments only; source snapshots retain exact bytes.
Identical statement text across candidate modules is one contract schema with separately authenticated implementation instances, not one universal theorem across all future implementations.
Carrier and no-carrier held variants share public Bool statement but have distinct proof bodies; carrier-only complete observation remains a historical accepted contract.
The equivalent codepoint refactor changes one support proof body. Tag variants reuse identical proof/reference bodies against distinct helper implementations.
Baseline is the established Phase96+97 catalog only; earlier proof pilots and finite production/projection cases are not added to universal law counts.
Formal acceptance does not promote any native optimization or prove C ownership.
